versions.changelog: ClawHub-safe: remove subprocess and LYGO_STACK_ROOT exec; pure in-package stdlib; declare permissions

- Enhanced local security: skill now runs purely within its package, with no network, subprocess, or external stack execution.
- All biometric IBI processing, digest, and waveform synthesis handled by in-package stdlib code.
- Outputs are restricted to summaries and protocol digests only; no raw IBI stored in output.
- New scripts added: core processing (traumacodex_core.py), local verification, and self-check.
- Updated and expanded documentation for setup, commands, and security posture.

Initial release of lygo-traumacodex.

- Maps biometric entropy (P7) to P8 LDQ waveform synthesis for offline and online analysis.
- Supports dual-mode: offline-first with online digests and summaries.
- Enables Layer D living-mesh healing-code protocol seals (not medical treatment).
- Integrates into the LYGO protocol stack for secure data routing and sealing.
- No raw biometrics transmitted; lattice remains open for protocol seals only.
